name: Next Steps Commitment Canvas
deliverable: Explicit contractual agreement covering resources, cadence, and sign-offs

steps.text: Frame the canvas as a charter the room signs today.
Fill scope, resources, review cadence, and the risks that could break the whole commitment.
Write done as a check that can pass or fail.
Read it back, have each member sign, and publish it.

failure: Hidden starvation: the team signs an ambitious scope while every hour is already promised elsewhere.
intervention: Before signing, ask what each person will drop to make room; if nothing is named, cut the scope.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: A workshop charter format in wide use; no single documented originator.
